title: Plaid pricing - Free sandbox, then $0.10-$0.60 per successful API call
clean_text: Plaid's Sandbox/development plan is free ($0/month). Production usage on the Pay-as-you-go (Launch) plan is billed per successful API call, with most products charging roughly $0.10-$0.60 per call depending on the specific product and volume tier; Plaid does not publish exact rates for most production use cases. Growth and Custom/Enterprise tiers are custom-priced based on API products used, call volume, support needs, and contract terms, typically with monthly or annual minimum commitments of $1,000-$10,000+ depending on scale. Unit pricing decreases as monthly call volume increases.
